description: L2 diagnostic runtime triage dashboard: where pipeline runtime loses time, fails, accumulates backlog, or raises warning/error conditions. Prometheus-first answer row first; logs/traces stay in a collapsed drilldown row for the optional tracing profile. Retry-vs-failure and batch-size distribution remain blocked pending bounded runtime instrumentation, so the dashboard only uses shipped metric families and recording rules.

options.content: 0. Control Plane1. Overview2. Runtime3. Provider Health4. Data Quality5. WorkflowSilver Reject ExplorerExplore LogsExplore Traces

panels.title: Review Dashboard Navigation
panels.description: Top navigation bus for the dashboard suite. Uses same-tab handoffs, preserves the current time range for dashboard-to-dashboard links, resets unsupported dashboard-specific scope where needed, and exposes Explore Logs plus an Explore Traces adjunct that is available only for traced runs with a safe bounded 150m Tempo handoff.

links.title: 3. Provider Health
links.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Visible workflow/pipeline/run_type are preserved; provider remains fail-closed when unknown.

links.title: 4. Data Quality
links.tooltip: Open the Data Quality dashboard in the same tab.

links.title: 5. Workflow
links.tooltip: Scoped handoff: passes workflow/pipeline/run_type context; Workflow owns its status and step filters.

links.title: Silver Reject Explorer
links.tooltip: Cross-scope handoff: bounded pipeline/run_type explorer scope. Reset scope: Silver Reject Explorer owns its own record-level filters. Opens in the same tab.

links.title: Explore Logs
links.tooltip: Requires optional tracing profile. Opens Logs Drilldown in the same tab with safe {job="bioetl"} baseline. Zero lines can legitimately mean Loki shipping is disabled, no BioETL log streams were shipped in range, or the baseline query still needs refinement inside Explore.

links.title: Explore Traces
links.tooltip: Available only for traced runs. Enable tracing with --tracing or BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED=true. Opens Traces Drilldown in the same tab with bounded pipeline TraceQL scope. NoOpTracing or tracing-off runs can legitimately be empty, so treat this as adjunct evidence rather than first-screen proof.

panels.title: Provenance
panels.description: Unified context/provenance banner for 2. Runtime. Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Workflow is context/evidence unless documented otherwise; run_id is local control-plane identity context only.

options.content: What is blocking runtime execution right now?

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Primary compact Runtime verdict for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Workflow is context/evidence only; run_id is local control-plane identity context and does not filter Prometheus. Runtime Status below is an expanded first-screen mirror of this same current-status recording rule, not an independent second verdict.

panels.title: ID
panels.description: Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels.

panels.title: Processed Records
panels.description: Current stage/outcome accounting evidence for the shared pipeline/run_type context. Uses bounded stage/outcome accounting recording rules; missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage.

Expanded mirror of the shared Runtime Status verdict, placed beside blocker causes for first-screen triage. Uses the same current-status recording rule as the compact Status panel: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN/no runtime status data; it is not an independent second signal. If UNKNOWN, check Runtime Telemetry Gap and Prometheus scrape/rule health before trusting zero count panels. Labels: pipeline, run_type. Next action: inspect top blocker reason, then active blocker detail or logs/traces.
panels.title: Runtime Status

panels.description: Current scrape/rule-health gap for BioETL runtime metrics over 10m. 0=OK/scraping and runtime dashboard recording rules evaluated recently, 1=WARN/no recent scrape, rule-evaluation failures, missing rule group, or stale rule group evaluation, >=2=CRIT/scrape plus rule-health gap, null=UNKNOWN/no scrape series. Time scope: current monitoring health, not selected-range runtime evidence. If this is non-zero or UNKNOWN, treat zero count panels as inconclusive and open Prometheus Targets before debugging pipeline code.

targets.expr: clamp_max(max(1 - max_over_time(up{job="bioetl"}[10m])) + on() group_left() ((sum(increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total{rule_group=~".*bioetl_observability[.]yml;bioetl_runtime_dashboard_recording$"}[10m])) > bool 0) or ((time() - max(prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{rule_group=~".*bioetl_observability[.]yml;bioetl_runtime_dashboard_recording$"})) > bool 60) or absent(prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{rule_group=~".*bioetl_observability[.]yml;bioetl_runtime_dashboard_recording$"})), 2)

panels.title: Runtime Telemetry Gap

panels.description: Top active runtime blocker reasons for the selected pipeline/run_type with severity and action_target labels. Time scope: current recording-rule snapshot. Empty table means no current blocker reason only when Runtime Status and Runtime Telemetry Gap are not UNKNOWN. Use the Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail drilldown for complete reason evidence.
panels.title: Runtime Blockers

panels.description: 15m current-window count of active canonical runtime blocker reasons for the selected pipeline/run_type. This is a blocker count, not a severity value: 0=OK only when status and telemetry are present, >=1=CRIT/action required, null=UNKNOWN. The query intentionally ignores $stage to avoid filtering away output/gold blockers. Next action: inspect top blocker detail.

targets.expr: sum((bioetl_runtime_current_blocker_reason{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"} > 0) or (((bioetl_runtime_current_blocker_reason{run_type=~"$run_type"}) > 0) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$"))) or ((max((bioetl_runtime_current_status{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or ((bioetl_runtime_current_status{run_type=~"$run_type"}) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$"))) == 0) * 0)

panels.title: Monitor Runtime Blockers

panels.description: Failed pipeline executions over the last 15m for selected pipeline/run_type. 0 means no failed-run counter increase only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; UNKNOWN/No data or telemetry gap means the failure count is inconclusive. Next action: open logs/traces or the pipeline failure runbook.

dataLinks.title: Open Logs (Loki, contextual scope marker, tracing)

panels.title: Failed Runs

panels.description: Pipeline-level runtime error rate over last 30m. bioetl_errors_total is scoped by pipeline/stage/error_code, so this panel intentionally ignores run_type in the numerator and uses Bronze input as denominator. Thresholds align with the shipped alert rule: >=5% is WARN when the 30m Bronze denominator is >=20, >=20% is CRIT/dashboard escalation; denominator <20 or missing input telemetry renders UNKNOWN instead of false OK/CRIT. Next action: open Errors by Stage/Error Code and check failed runs/backlog/lag.

targets.expr: (((((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_errors_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",stage=~"$stage"}[30m])) or sum((max_over_time(bioetl_errors_total{stage=~"$stage"}[30m])) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$"))) or (0 * ((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",stage="bronze"}[30m])) or sum((max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{stage="bronze"}[30m])) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$")))))) / clamp_min(((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",stage="bronze"}[30m])) or sum((max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{stage="bronze"}[30m])) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$")))), 1))) and ((((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",stage="bronze"}[30m])) or sum((max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{stage="bronze"}[30m])) and on(pipeline) label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "pipeline_raw", "$pipeline", "", ""), "pipeline", "$1", "pipeline_raw", "^(?:workflow_)?(.*)$")))) >= 20)))

panels.title: Runtime Error Rate

panels.description: Worst observed stage lag across stages over the last 15m for selected pipeline/run_type. This intentionally ignores the stage variable to surface the worst blocker. Thresholds align with the shipped alert rule: >=300s is WARN, >=900s is CRIT/dashboard escalation. No data is UNKNOWN/missing lag telemetry; 0 is only valid when the metric is scraped and no lag is present. Next action: expand Track Stage Backlog Trend and logs.
panels.title: Worst Stage Lag
First Action
panels.description: First operator action for Runtime triage. Uses current snapshot panels before selected-range evidence. UNKNOWN means missing status telemetry or scrape/rule gap until proven otherwise.

options.content:
Read Runtime Status, then inspect the top blocker reason.
If status is CRIT, open Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail,
if WARN, inspect terminal-run/stage lag evidence,
if UNKNOWN, verify Runtime Telemetry Gap before treating zero as OK.

panels.description: Sustained backlog accumulation by stage.
panels.title: Track Stage Backlog Trend

panels.description: Shows expected vs observed stage status per entity config. Gold status is contextual: expected (scd2/append/overwrite config), disabled (gold_enabled=false), pending (run active, gold not yet written), or missing (run completed, gold=0).
panels.title: Inspect Stage Expectedness

panels.description: Processed records by stage over the active Grafana interval.
panels.title: Track Records by Stage / Interval

panels.description: Shows each active runtime blocker recording rule with its current value for the selected pipeline/run_type where the source metric exposes run_type. Empty table means no active blockers only when Runtime Status and Runtime Telemetry Gap are not UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail

panels.description: Phase latency distribution across p50, p95, and p99 for the selected pipeline. "No phase duration samples in range" means no phase duration histogram buckets were emitted in the selected range. Possible causes: run still active, metric not emitted, or label mismatch. Unlike pipeline duration below, this panel does not filter by $run_type/$stage.

defaults.noValue: No phase duration samples in range

panels.title: Track Pipeline Phase Duration p50/p95/p99

panels.description: Pipeline duration percentiles by stage. "No terminal pipeline duration samples" means no completed pipeline runs emitted duration histogram buckets in the selected range. Possible causes: run still active, terminal metric not emitted, query label mismatch.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"(${pipeline:regex}|workflow_${pipeline:regex})",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Track Pipeline Duration p50/p95/p99

panels.description: Error breakdown by stage and error code over the selected Grafana time range. Empty table means no error samples in range, not a synthetic domain value.
panels.title: Inspect Errors by Stage / Error Code / Range

panels.description: Processed-record totals over the active range, grouped by stage and run_type. Empty bargauge means no processed-record samples in range.
panels.title: Track Records by Stage / Run Type / Range

panels.description: Runtime-owned selected-window handoff summary from shipped 15m/30m recording rules for preflight, infrastructure, failed-run, and error-rate blockers. 0 means no condition rule is firing only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive. Next action: use Inspect Active Runtime Blocker Detail or the pipeline failure runbook.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_preflight_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_infrastructure_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_runs_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_runtime_error_rate_high_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Monitor Pipeline Alert Conditions

panels.description: No-records runs detected over the last 30m for selected pipeline/run_type. This is a runtime blocker candidate when runs occurred but no records were processed. 0 is valid only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; telemetry gaps are inconclusive. Next action: inspect checkpoint/resume and stage expectedness. Open 0. Control Plane from the navigation bus when checkpoint/resume investigation is needed.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_pipeline_runs_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0) unless on (pipeline, run_type) (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0))) or ((count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0) * 0)

panels.title: Monitor No-Records Runs

panels.description: Adaptive memory pressure state over the last 15m. 0=OK/no active pressure, 1=WARN/runtime memory pressure active, >=2=CRIT reserved for future severity recording rules, null=UNKNOWN/missing memory telemetry. This is stage-level and intentionally ignores run_type because the metric labels are pipeline/stage/reason/monitor_mode/status. Next action: open logs and inspect checkpoint/resume pressure before retrying.
panels.title: Monitor Memory Pressure Active

panels.description: DQ handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m DQ recording rules to show whether runtime symptoms may be downstream of data-quality failures. Runtime does not diagnose record-level DQ here; open Data Quality for reasons, thresholds, and Silver rejects. 0 is normal only when the selected runtime pipeline universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_soft_threshold_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_hard_fail_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_critical_anomaly_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_silver_validation_failures_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Inspect DQ Alert Conditions

panels.description: Control Plane / Replay Safety handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m recording rules for manifest, checkpoint, replay, and lineage blockers. Runtime does not decide replay/resume safety here; open Control Plane for manifest, checkpoint, and ledger evidence. 0 is normal only when the selected runtime pipeline/run_type universe exists; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive. Open 0. Control Plane from the navigation bus for manifest, checkpoint, and replay evidence.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_manifest_write_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_ledger_append_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_checkpoint_incompatible_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_lag_high_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_drift_detected_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_lineage_refs_missing_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_runtime_pipeline_run_type_universe{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Inspect Control-plane Alert Conditions

panels.description: Selected-pipeline provider alert handoff scoped strictly to $provider_hint. All shipped 15m/30m/1h provider recording-rule conditions are summed only for that provider label; there is no global fallback in this card. 0 is normal only when the hinted provider exists in bioetl_provider_current_status; UNKNOWN means missing provider telemetry or an unknown hint. Open Provider Health for root-cause evidence.

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Provider alert query may scope by $provider_hint when validated.

targets.expr: (((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_failure_rate_high_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_retries_exhausted_1h{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_http_error_rate_high_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_tokens_depleted_15m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_adapter_latency_high_30m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_wait_high_30m{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_provider_current_status{provider=~"$provider_hint"}) > bool 0))

panels.title: Inspect Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: GLOBAL provider-independent 30m alert addends only: adapter latency and rate-limiter wait recording rules summed cluster-wide. This is not selected-pipeline localization; use Inspect Provider Alert Conditions for $provider_hint-scoped evidence. 0 is normal only when provider telemetry exists; UNKNOWN means missing bioetl_provider_current_status anchor.

dataLinks.title: Open 3. Provider Health
dataLinks.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. GLOBAL card sums cluster-wide adapter latency and rate-limiter wait conditions.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_adapter_latency_high_30m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_wait_high_30m) or vector(0))) and on() (count(bioetl_provider_current_status) > bool 0)

panels.title: Inspect GLOBAL Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: Freshness evidence handoff only. Counts selected-pipeline entities older than 24h from raw data freshness telemetry; this supports source/DQ escalation and is not a Runtime execution blocker or recording-rule alert condition by itself. 0 means no stale entity when freshness telemetry is available; UNKNOWN means missing freshness telemetry.
panels.title: Inspect Freshness Lagged Entities >24h

panels.description: GLOBAL graceful-shutdown initiation events over the active Grafana interval, grouped by reason and not filtered by $pipeline/$run_type because the source metric has only reason. Use this as process-level shutdown context, not pipeline-scoped runtime evidence.
panels.title: Track GLOBAL Shutdown Initiated by Reason / Interval

panels.description: GLOBAL graceful-shutdown completion events over the active Grafana interval, grouped by reason and not filtered by $pipeline/$run_type because the source metric has only reason. Compare with initiated events for process-level shutdown completion context.
panels.title: Track GLOBAL Shutdown Completed by Reason / Interval
Tracing-only Log Hygiene (requires optional tracing profile)

panels.description: Pipeline-scoped structured warning logs for the selected pipeline over the active range. Columns are parsed JSON fields (not a single flattened line).
panels.title: Inspect Warning Logs

panels.description: GLOBAL log events that failed JSON parsing or are missing expected fields over the active range. Not pipeline-scoped runtime evidence; compare with pipeline-scoped warning logs.
panels.title: Inspect GLOBAL Unstructured Logs

panels.description: Top parsed warning events by bounded event/logger dimensions over the active Grafana range. This avoids grouping by raw message text, which can include dynamic identifiers and create noisy high-cardinality series. run_type is intentionally not filtered because structured logs do not guarantee a run_type field.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (event, logger) (count_over_time({job="bioetl"} | json | __error__="" | pipeline=~"$pipeline" | level="warning" [$__range])))

panels.title: Inspect Top Warning Events by Event / Logger / Range

panels.description: GLOBAL trend of structured vs unstructured log events over time by Interval. Unstructured parser-error events cannot be safely pipeline-filtered, so this panel is process-level log hygiene evidence and not selected-pipeline runtime status.
panels.title: Track GLOBAL Log Hygiene Trend
